objective: Migrate the existing 121-city library and newly generated cities to a coherent v6.1 three-call, source-native and honestly graded approximation path.

supersedes.note: The v6.0 manifest and spent holdouts remain immutable historical evidence. Its all-19 independent-validation requirement is structurally unreachable and is not a v6.1 release blocker.

food.streetBudgetCompatibilityProvenance: (6 * 0.2757) / (4 * 0.2757 + 2), preserving the v6.0 low-cost basket relationship; generated and grade D

derivationContract.fallback: One tier-vector fallback per category: observed source tiers, then regional tier vector, then global tier vector. Grade D. No anchor-prior plus direct-tier-prior chain.

evidenceReuse.holdoutPolicy: All v6.0 holdout measures are spent and remain closed. No v6.1 holdout is collected, frozen or read.

releaseScope.cutover: Requires a complete staged 121-city artifact and explicit owner approval.
releaseScope.rollback: Restore the pre-migration CSV and unset the feature flag together to retain v1.

1_developmentFixtureCoverage.requirement: All 19 product tiers are numeric for all 25 development fixtures.
1_developmentFixtureCoverage.measurement: Computed by the deterministic fixture replay.

1_runtimeCoverage.requirement: Monitor at least 95% complete v6.1 generation as a post-release operational SLO; do not infer population reliability from a 19/20 pre-release sample.
1_runtimeCoverage.measurement: Not established by development replay or experiment 010, which made zero provider calls. The pre-release delegated canary measures source-contract feasibility and deterministic processing; a separate small user-key smoke tests provider transport before cutover.

1_delegatedOperationalCanary.requirement: At least 19/20 registered cities have three schema-valid delegated source records and complete shipped Stage-B materializations; every call/search/read/provenance gate passes and artifact candidates, including all-prior cities, affect no more than 30% of the batch.
1_delegatedOperationalCanary.measurement: A fresh experiment is required after production search/date/evaluator defects are fixed. Experiment 010 is not this measurement.

2_schemaAndMissingness.requirement: Every v6.1 source response validates; non-observations remain not_found, blocked, stale or class_absent and are never silently substituted in collection.

3_provenanceAndGrades.requirement: Every tier carries evidenceBasis, evidenceGrade, interval, sourceIds, modelVersions and imputedMeasures. Grade C/D is never renderable as observed.

4_algebraicCoherence.requirement: All tier values are finite and non-negative. Food satisfies street <= budget <= mid <= high; drinks satisfy coffee <= none <= light <= moderate <= heavy; activities satisfy free <= budget <= mid <= high; accommodation follows the shipped ladder ordering.

5_accommodationAccuracy.requirement: Carry forward the genuine development accommodation result without refit.

6_sourceDependenceDisclosure.requirement: Report direct-source and grade-D fallback rates per category and region. Food/activity are labelled BYT source-backed, drinks are labelled source-priced presets, and none is called independently validated.

7_deterministicReplay.requirement: The same normalized v6.1 fixture bundle materializes byte-identical 19-tier values and provenance under --check.

8_refreshEconomics.requirement: Exactly three primary calls, at most ten searches and zero direct page reads per city.

9_integrationAndRollback.requirement: The pure v6.1 persistence adapter and provenance parser round-trip a representative materialization; flag-off remains v1; the 121-city CSV is byte-identical.

10_verification.requirement: TypeScript, build, tests, docs memory check, generated coefficient/prior checks and v6.1 release report all pass.
10_verification.measurement: The release validator records this as external evidence; it cannot observe a command log.

nonGates.all19IndependentAccuracy: Not required: behavioural presets do not have independent city-price ground truth.
nonGates.cityRankingAgainstFullIndependentBasket: Deferred until a separate category-total panel is approved; not a v6.1 release blocker.
nonGates.noRegressionVsV1Across15Of19: Informational A/B only because independent truth is unavailable for most behavioural tiers.
